summary: Log cabin lookout on Clearwater National Forest, built 1930 per the Forest Service list and gone by 1960; no source describes the site today.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Clearwater National Forest

access.note: Hike-in site on Clearwater National Forest land; no source describes a closure

visit.trail_note: Listed as hike-in by Idaho Fire Lookouts; the sources give no route details

events.note: Forest Service list gives 1930; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give only the 1930s
All three sources record the cabin as gone in 1960; the sources give no reason

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service list gives 1930; the two websites give only the 1930s. The exact year is kept, and the 1930s wording is kept in the notes.

notes_for_editor: Built year is 1930 from the Forest Service list; the websites say 1930s. No source gives a reason for the 1960 removal. Access is marked public from National Forest land and the hike-in tag; no source says so directly. No staffing history in any source. No new photos found.
